scenes.event: Arthur is leaving for a lakeside retreat to focus on his mental well-being.
scenes.location: College campus, near the bus stop
scenes.description: Arthur is preparing to leave for the lakeside, standing at the bus stop with his backpack. His friend Cici and boyfriend Jay are there to see him off. The atmosphere is calm but charged with unspoken emotions.

characters.name: Arthur Hicks
characters.description: A sensitive and introspective 20-year-old college student who is determined to find mental clarity through solitude.; Male/College Student, 20 years old; Occupation: College Student; Personality: Sensitive, Thoughtful, Determined, Introspective; Values: Self-exploration, Independence, Emotional honesty; Interests: Self-reflection, Travel, Mental clarity; Experiences: Academic life, Interpersonal relationships, Emotional transitions, Decision-making under pressure

characters.name: Cici
characters.description: Cici is Arthur's close friend, known for her empathy and concern; she is a supportive presence in his life. Female; Age: 22; Occupation: Psychology major and campus peer counselor; Personality: Compassionate, observant, resilient; Values: Mental health, loyalty, emotional honesty; Interests: Journaling, nature walks, music therapy; Experiences: Volunteered at a crisis hotline, supported a close friend through anxiety, participated in mindfulness workshops.

characters.name: Jay
characters.description: Jay, a thoughtful and emotionally honest man, is standing at the bus stop on a quiet college campus in the morning, saying goodbye to Arthur as he leaves for a lakeside retreat. Male; Age: 24; Occupation: Psychology graduate student; Personality: empathetic, anxious, hopeful; Values: emotional honesty, respect, support; Interests: journaling, indie music, nature walks; Experiences: has supported Arthur through past mental health struggles, recently navigated personal relationship insecurities.

actions.dialogue: Arthur, I really want to come with you. You don't have to do this alone, you know.
I appreciate the offer, Cici, but I need to be alone right now. This is something I have to do for myself.
Just promise me you'll send a voice message every day. I want to know you're safe and thinking of us.
I'll see. I want to focus on myself, but I won't forget you two. Thank you for caring.
We're here for you, no matter what. You're not alone in this, even if you're not with us.

scenes.plot: Arthur is about to embark on a solo journey to the lakeside to find clarity and independence. Cici and Jay, both deeply caring, attempt to support him in their own ways, but Arthur remains steadfast in his decision to go alone. The interaction highlights his internal struggle and the subtle tension between his need for solitude and his emotional connections.
scenes.social_purpose: To explore the protagonist's values of independence and self-exploration while showcasing the dynamics of his relationships with friends and his partner.

chunk.text: Arthur stands at the bus stop, his backpack slung over one shoulder, watching the lake retreat on the horizon. Cici and Jay linger behind him, their concern palpable. As the bus pulls up, Arthur gives them a small smile, takes a deep breath, and steps on board, leaving behind a mix of hope and worry in his wake.
